name: Channel Infrastructure NZ Limited
summary: Channel Infrastructure NZ Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides infrastructure solutions to meet fuel and energy needs in New Zealand. The company offers fuels import terminal system, including jetty infrastructure at Marsden Point, storage tanks, Marsden Point to Auckland pipeline, and Somerton pipeline, as well as wiri leasing services. It also provides fuel testing laboratory services. The company was formerly known as The New Zealand Refining Company Limited and changed its name to Channel Infrastructure NZ Limited in March 2022. Channel Infrastructure NZ Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Whangarei, New Zealand.
